name: Rafaela
source: The offspring of a demon and succubus, Rafaela is the leader of the largest and most notorious pirate gang in the vicinity. A hedonist who indulges her whims and desires to the extreme, she is sceptical of the legend of the Coral Sea King and does not have a wish she wants fulfilled. Instead she derives pleasure from seeking out and crushing the other factions carrying the rings which she covets for their beauty.
